title: Starting to Exercise After Thirty
paragraphs: At thirty-four, Rasha realized she had not exercised regularly since university, and simple activities like climbing stairs had started leaving her more out of breath than she was comfortable admitting.
She joined a local gym, feeling embarrassed at first watching younger members complete exercises she found genuinely difficult, occasionally considering quitting after only a few sessions.
A trainer noticed her hesitation and reassured her that comparing her first month to someone else's years of consistent training was neither fair nor useful for her own progress.
Six months later, Rasha noticed she could climb the same stairs without losing her breath, a small but genuinely meaningful change that motivated her to keep her new routine going.
